messages:
Dana Liu: Heads-up from Nimbus: they want an "one-click" private offer in the marketplace w/ immediate activation + a small migration credit to incentivize pre-list customers. Can we scope risks?
Vikram Shah: Ops: marketplace needs SKU metadata 48h before listing. immediate activation is possible if we issue a temp mapping token. must track swaps for billing.
Sasha Cole: Partnerships: Nimbus insists on a 90-day migration credit and step-down discounts over 3 years. also wants co-announcement slot with partner marketing.
Maya (Finance): Finance concerns: credits impact recognized revenue. propose credit cap = min($75k, 12% of committed spend). prefer credits as contra-revenue. need GL mapping.
Sam (Legal): Legal flags: we must include explicit renewal step schedule in private offer T&Cs (e.g., 22% year1, 14% year2, 8% year3) or auto-renew chaos. require 60-day SKU deprecation notice and appendix for SKU mapping.
Vikram Shah: Tech question: if we allow early activation, do we allow usage during the pre-list period to count against the committed bucket? might complicate marketplace reporting.
Maya (Finance): counting is ok but we need auditability. require usage reports from partner/SI and a reconciliation window (30 days).
Marketplace-Bot: Created task #5492: generate SKU mapping CSV and temp token flow. Assignee: eng-ops. ETA 24h.
Sasha Cole: Marketing ask: embargo on public materials until soft-list date. partner wants private customer references earlier; legal approval required.
Sam (Legal): Draft checklist:
- Private offer T&Cs attached to marketplace listing
- Explicit renewal discount table
- Credit cap clause + accounting treatment language
- Appendix A: SKU mapping & 60-day deprecation notice
- Embargo clause & NDA for partner comms
Maya (Finance): Also must model marketplace take (e.g., 7%) into net economics. credits should reduce net ARR in the model. I'll run scenarios and share.
Vikram Shah: Ops implementation plan:
1) issue temp mapping token for activation
2) log activation and map to metered SKU id
3) on metadata publish, swap to marketplace SKU and emit audit event
4) reconcile usage monthly against committed spend
Dana Liu: For the migration credit: suggest one-time credit code applied on first invoice after conversion, expires after 90 days. cap it and mark it as contra-revenue.
Sam (Legal): Add clause preventing public disclosure of private pricing until listing goes live. Also require partner to honor customer confidentiality.
Sasha Cole: Partner negotiation point: Nimbus wants the credit to be applied automatically when they convert. Ops needs to ensure the automation is robust.
Vikram Shah: We'll build a guarded automation with manual rollback. need partner to provide conversion webhook.
Maya (Finance): Action items for finance: set cap, GL treatment, and communicate to rev ops. Ill send model by EOD.
Sam (Legal): I'll draft T&Cs + appendix and circulate redlines by tomorrow noon.
Dana Liu: Great. Marketplace-Bot, ping marketplace liaisons for a soft-list slot next week.
Marketplace-Bot: @marketplace-liaison pinged  awaiting available soft-list windows from AWS/GCP. ETA 18h. :robot_face:
Sasha Cole: Summary of decisions: allow early activation w/ temp mapping, migration credit allowed (capped), include renewal step-down schedule, 60-day SKU deprecation appendix, marketing embargo until soft-list. Reconvene 10am PT tomorrow to sign off.
